lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance, circular pixel clusters organized into several semi-parallel horizontal rows across the mid-lateral flank, with the highest concentration and size located posterior to the fourth and fifth gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, creating a rectilinear grid of anchor nodes across the visible mid-section of the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple prominent horizontal linear features are visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient transition from light pixels on the upper surface to shadowed pixels on the lower surface.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of several Echeneidae (remora) specimens attached to the ventral surface and swimming in close proximity to the trailing edge of the pectoral fin.
